info.name: Open Exchange Rates API
info.description: Live and historical foreign exchange (forex) rates for 200+ world currencies as plain-text JSON over HTTPS. Base URL: https://openexchangerates.org/api. Every data request requires an App ID (app_id query parameter or Authorization: Token header). Feature access is tiered by plan - base currency change requires a paid plan, time-series requires Enterprise or Unlimited, convert requires Unlimited, and OHLC requires VIP Platinum. Requests to currencies.json and usage.json do not count against your quota.

query.description: Base currency (3-letter code, default USD; paid plans only).
Include alternative, black market, and digital currency rates.

request.description: Returns the latest exchange rates relative to the base currency (USD by default). Refresh frequency depends on plan: hourly (Free/Developer), 30 minutes (Enterprise), 5 minutes (Unlimited).

item.name: Get historical exchange rates for a date

query.description: Include alternative and black market rates.

variable.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC), back to 1999-01-01.

request.description: Returns end-of-day exchange rates for the requested UTC date, currently going back to January 1st, 1999.

item.name: Get bulk daily rates for a date range

query.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Max range is one month.
Recommended to limit results and payload size.

request.description: Returns daily historical rates for a date range (max one month). Each day counts as one API request. Enterprise and Unlimited plans.

item.name: Convert a value between two currencies

variable.description: The base (from) currency as a 3-letter code.
The target (to) currency as a 3-letter code.

request.description: Converts a value between two currencies at the latest API rates, returning the rate and timestamp used plus the converted amount. Unlimited plan only.

query.description: Include alternative, digital, and unofficial currencies.

request.description: Returns a JSON map of all available 3-letter currency codes to full currency names. No App ID required; does not count against your usage quota.

item.name: Get OHLC rates for a period

query.description: ISO-8601 UTC start time with zero seconds.

request.description: Returns open, high, low, close, and time-weighted average rates for a period. Data from December 19th, 2016. VIP Platinum tier only.

item.name: Get account plan and usage statistics

request.description: Returns plan information and usage statistics for the App ID - status, plan, quota, update frequency, features, requests made/remaining, and daily average. Does not count against your usage quota.
